caption: Fun times today with @innschris testing out the latest iteration of my Sangha Looper. Psychedelic and exploratory - I think we have the makings of an improvised dance set 😃 ... Can't wait to try it out!

I've been taking a step back from DJing for a bit this summer to work on some new music, but excited to announce I'm back with a few gigs booked:
😈 ED Brighton, Fri Oct 6th (Shadow Rave) 
🌙 ED UK, Wed Oct 28th
🐉 ED Wales, Jan '27

Such a blast playing with the supremely talented @phoebegarratt this afternoon. Multiplayer loops with Sangha Looper, think we're getting near to a V1 now! I just need to sort out my Apple developer account and I can share it with you all properly. #loopstation

Celebrating my DJ debut at @ecstaticdance.uk 3 years ago today! Here's @dominika_mak bringing us home a couple of weeks ago, with a live version of a track we collaborated on. It was a quiet storm in the peak of a heatwave, hottest dance of the year and my favourite one so far. Full set on my SoundCloud 😊

Awesome jam today with the talented @dominika_mak! Playing with vocals and FX in my new project - a multiplayer looper called Sangha. Try it out yourself, it's free on MacOS as standalone and VST. The way it works is your Mac runs the loops and audio interface. Then you can control it with a phone or tablet on the same Wi-Fi. It's such fun and I'm so excited to see it come together - I've wanted this since working on @endlesssfm 6 years ago!

Made this artificial life thing. Plant like creatures breed and hybridise in a small floating world. 3D Petri dish. Thinking about how I can link music to it so the creatures respond in real time to tempo and mood. Try it for yourself, link on my GitHub. Works best on desktop 🤓✨
